message.neroeconomy.order.refunded: %s credits came back to you from escrow, because the price was below your limit.
message.neroeconomy.order.sell_listed: Listed %s × %s at %s credits each. When it sells, a market fee of %s%% comes out of what you receive (order %s).

message.neroeconomy.order.unknown_item: there is no such item; type a full item id such as minecraft:diamond
message.neroeconomy.order.untradeable: that item cannot be traded on this server
message.neroeconomy.order.wrong_item: that is not the item the order wants
message.neroeconomy.rule.funds_locked: the budget would have to come out of your starting balance, which unlocks after more play time
message.neroeconomy.rule.insufficient_fu: you do not have enough credits for the budget
message.neroeconomy.rule.invalid: the price, the quantity per day or the total is not valid
message.neroeconomy.rule.limit_reached: you already have as many rules as the server allows
message.neroeconomy.rule.not_found: no rule of yours has that id
message.neroeconomy.rule.refund_blocked: the rule's budget could not be paid back just now; the rule is paused instead. Collect your waiting credits and try again
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.daily_ca: paused until tomorrow: your rules have traded as much as they may in one day
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.filled: complete: it has sold its whole quantity
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.nothing_: waiting: there is nothing to sell in its inventory
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.order_li: waiting: you have too many open orders for it to place its own
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.out_of_b: stopped: its budget cannot buy any more, or the listing fee cannot be paid
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.price_no: waiting: nobody is trading at its price yet
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.storage_: waiting: there is no room for what it buys
message.neroeconomy.rule.status.unreacha: paused: its inventory is in a chunk that is not loaded
message.neroeconomy.rule.unknown_binding: that inventory cannot back a rule
message.neroeconomy.rule.unknown_item: there is no such item; type a full item id such as minecraft:diamond
message.neroeconomy.rule.unknown_tag: there is no such item tag, or it has no items in it
message.neroeconomy.rule.untradeable: that item cannot be traded on this server
